about_the_game:
ONCE UPON A GALAXY is a fast-paced, NO WAITING card battler with innovative mechanics created by Million Dreams Games. This indie studio boasts a talented team with leads who worked on iconic games like Magic: The Gathering, Hearthstone, and Runeterra.

YOU are at the helm of your own journey! Choose your own crew and assemble new combos and synergies in ways no one has ever seen! Battle across a spectacular galaxy of your favorite Storybook Characters, Legends of Myth, Cosmic Celestial Entities, Powerful Pirates, and Ferocious Animals! Gather treasures and cast spells to strengthen your crew as you battle through opponents to be the last one standing and claim ultimate victory!

What is "Asynchronous Game Mode"? Real opponents, with NO waiting. Have just a couple minutes to play? Have an hour? It doesn't matter! You can start a game, stop in a mid run then pick it back up as you please!

This is a HUGE innovation for the card battler genre! You gotta try it to see how fun it is, but here is the quick explanation - When you start a game, you are facing REAL boards (or "decks") from REAL human players that took their turns earlier. Similar to a racing game where you are facing a time trial of a "ghost car" that was driven by another real player from earlier that day. The other players have made real drafting decisions, real board placement decisions and you are now facing their deck to see how you can fair. Once you finish your run, your deck joins the pool of potential opponents for others to challenge. It's fast, strategic, and endlessly fun!

Give ONCE UPON A GALAXY a try and experience the thrill of this groundbreaking card battler. We think you'll love it!

mac_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires an Apple processor
  • OS: 11.0 (Big Sur)
  • Processor: Apple M1
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: OpenGL 3.3 or Metal
  • Storage: 1 GB available space

  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: 2.3 GHz
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: 2GB VRAM, OpenGL 3.3 or Vulkan 1.1
  • Storage: 1 GB available space

short_description: ONCE UPON A GALAXY is an easy to learn Card Battler with incredible strategic depth and near infinite fun! Which of your favorite characters from myth and fairy tale will you choose? Our indie team of former Magic and Hearthstone devs hopes you enjoy our game!
